issue_request: FHIR-47856 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification. It requested a doNotPerformReason element for MedicationRequest.doNotPerform safety rationale; the WG instead decided not to add a new element and to clarify MedicationRequest.reason plus the doNotPerform and Scope and Usage text.

additional_context: FHIR-51447 later clarified MedicationRequest.basedOn versus MedicationRequest.reason and must be preserved. FHIR-51148 later added AllergyIntolerance as a MedicationRequest.reason target for doNotPerform allergy scenarios, supporting the conclusion that .reason remains the appropriate rationale element for negative medication orders.
